verses.ar: طٰهٰ
verses.en: Ta-Ha

verses.ar: مَا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لِتَشۡقٰ٘يۙ‏
verses.en: We have not sent down the Qur'an to thee to be (an occasion) for thy distress

verses.ar: اِلَّا تَذۡكِرَةً لِّمَنۡ يَّخۡشٰيۙ‏
verses.en: But only as an admonition to those who fear (Allah)

verses.ar: تَنۡزِيۡلًا مِّمَّنۡ خَلَقَ الۡاَرۡضَ وَالسَّمٰوٰتِ الۡعُلٰيؕ‏
verses.en: A revelation from Him Who created the earth and the heavens on high

verses.ar: اَلرَّحۡمٰنُ عَلَي الۡعَرۡشِ اسۡتَوٰي
verses.en: (Allah) Most Gracious is firmly established on the throne (of authority)

verses.ar: لَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحۡتَ الثَّرٰي
verses.en: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and on earth, and all between them, and all beneath the soil

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ تَجۡهَرۡ بِالۡقَوۡلِ فَاِنَّهٗ يَعۡلَمُ السِّرَّ وَاَخۡفٰي
verses.en: If thou pronounce the word aloud, (it is no matter): for verily He knoweth what is secret and what is yet more hidden

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَؕ لَهُ الۡاَسۡمَآءُ الۡحُسۡنٰي
verses.en: Allah! there is no god but He! To Him belong the most Beautiful Names

verses.ar: وَهَلۡ اَتٰىكَ حَدِيۡثُ مُوۡسٰيۘ‏
verses.en: Has the story of Moses reached thee

verses.ar: اِذۡ رَاٰ نَارًا فَقَالَ لِاَهۡلِهِ امۡكُثُوۡ٘ا اِنِّيۡ٘ اٰنَسۡتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّيۡ٘ اٰتِيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡهَا بِقَبَسٍ اَوۡ اَجِدُ عَلَي النَّارِ هُدًي
verses.en: Behold, he saw a fire: So he said to his family, "Tarry ye; I perceive a fire; perhaps I can bring you some burning brand therefrom, or find some guidance at the fire

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا٘ اَتٰىهَا نُوۡدِيَ يٰمُوۡسٰيؕ‏
verses.en: But when he came to the fire, a voice was heard: "O Moses

verses.ar: اِنِّيۡ٘ اَنَا رَبُّكَ فَاخۡلَعۡ نَعۡلَيۡكَۚ اِنَّكَ بِالۡوَادِ الۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوًيؕ‏
verses.en: Verily I am thy Lord! therefore (in My presence) put off thy shoes: thou art in the sacred valley Tuwa

verses.ar: وَاَنَا اخۡتَرۡتُكَ فَاسۡتَمِعۡ لِمَا يُوۡحٰي
verses.en: I have chosen thee: listen, then, to the inspiration (sent to thee)

verses.ar: اِنَّنِيۡ٘ اَنَا اللّٰهُ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا٘ اَنَا فَاعۡبُدۡنِيۡۙ وَاَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ لِذِكۡرِيۡ‏
verses.en: Verily, I am Allah: There is no god but I: So serve thou Me (only), and establish regular prayer for celebrating My praise

verses.ar: اِنَّ السَّاعَةَ اٰتِيَةٌ اَكَادُ اُخۡفِيۡهَا لِتُجۡزٰي كُلُّ نَفۡسٍۭ بِمَا تَسۡعٰي
verses.en: Verily the Hour is coming - My design is to keep it hidden - for every soul to receive its reward by the measure of its Endeavour

verses.ar: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنۡهَا مَنۡ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِهَا وَاتَّبَعَ هَوٰىهُ فَتَرۡدٰي
verses.en: Therefore let not such as believe not therein but follow their own lusts, divert thee therefrom, lest thou perish

verses.ar: وَمَا تِلۡكَ بِيَمِيۡنِكَ يٰمُوۡسٰي
verses.en: And what is that in the right hand, O Moses

verses.ar: قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَۚ اَتَوَكَّؤُا عَلَيۡهَا وَاَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلٰي غَنَمِيۡ وَلِيَ فِيۡهَا مَاٰرِبُ اُخۡرٰي
verses.en: He said, "It is my rod: on it I lean; with it I beat down fodder for my flocks; and in it I find other uses

verses.ar: قَالَ اَلۡقِهَا يٰمُوۡسٰي
verses.en: (Allah) said, "Throw it, O Moses

verses.ar: فَاَلۡقٰىهَا فَاِذَا هِيَ حَيَّةٌ تَسۡعٰي
verses.en: He threw it, and behold! It was a snake, active in motion

verses.ar: قَالَ خُذۡهَا وَلَا تَخَفۡࣞ سَنُعِيۡدُهَا سِيۡرَتَهَا الۡاُوۡلٰي
verses.en: (Allah) said, "Seize it, and fear not: We shall return it at once to its former condition

verses.ar: وَاضۡمُمۡ يَدَكَ اِلٰي جَنَاحِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوۡٓءٍ اٰيَةً اُخۡرٰيۙ‏
verses.en: Now draw thy hand close to thy side: It shall come forth white (and shining), without harm (or stain),- as another Sign

verses.ar: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنۡ اٰيٰتِنَا الۡكُبۡرٰيۚ‏
verses.en: In order that We may show thee (two) of our Greater Signs

verses.ar: اِذۡهَبۡ اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ اِنَّهٗ طَغٰيࣖ‏
verses.en: Go thou to Pharaoh, for he has indeed transgressed all bounds

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اشۡرَحۡ لِيۡ صَدۡرِيۡۙ‏
verses.en: (Moses) said: "O my Lord! expand me my breast

verses.ar: وَيَسِّرۡ لِيۡ٘ اَمۡرِيۡۙ‏
verses.en: Ease my task for me

verses.ar: وَاحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةً مِّنۡ لِّسَانِيۡۙ‏
verses.en: And remove the impediment from my speech

verses.ar: يَفۡقَهُوۡا قَوۡلِيۡࣕ‏
verses.en: So they may understand what I say

verses.ar: وَاجۡعَلۡ لِّيۡ وَزِيۡرًا مِّنۡ اَهۡلِيۡۙ‏
verses.en: And give me a Minister from my family

verses.ar: هٰرُوۡنَ اَخِيۙ‏
verses.en: Aaron, my brother

verses.ar: اشۡدُدۡ بِهٖ٘ اَزۡرِيۡۙ‏
verses.en: Add to my strength through him

verses.ar: وَاَشۡرِكۡهُ فِيۡ٘ اَمۡرِيۡۙ‏
verses.en: And make him share my task

verses.ar: كَيۡ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيۡرًاۙ‏
verses.en: That we may celebrate Thy praise without stint

verses.ar: وَّنَذۡكُرَكَ كَثِيۡرًاؕ‏
verses.en: And remember Thee without stint

verses.ar: اِنَّكَ كُنۡتَ بِنَا بَصِيۡرًا
verses.en: For Thou art He that (ever) regardeth us

verses.ar: قَالَ قَدۡ اُوۡتِيۡتَ سُؤۡلَكَ يٰمُوۡسٰي
verses.en: (Allah) said: "Granted is thy prayer, O Moses

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَيۡكَ مَرَّةً اُخۡرٰ٘يۙ‏
verses.en: And indeed We conferred a favour on thee another time (before)

verses.ar: اِذۡ اَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلٰ٘ي اُمِّكَ مَا يُوۡحٰ٘يۙ‏
verses.en: Behold! We sent to thy mother, by inspiration, the message

verses.ar: اَنِ اقۡذِفِيۡهِ فِي التَّابُوۡتِ فَاقۡذِفِيۡهِ فِي الۡيَمِّ فَلۡيُلۡقِهِ الۡيَمُّ بِالسَّاحِلِ يَاۡخُذۡهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّيۡ وَعَدُوٌّ لَّهٗؕ وَاَلۡقَيۡتُ عَلَيۡكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّيۡ ࣢ۚ وَلِتُصۡنَعَ عَلٰي عَيۡنِيۡۘ‏
verses.en: Throw (the child) into the chest, and throw (the chest) into the river: the river will cast him up on the bank, and he will be taken up by one who is an enemy to Me and an enemy to him': But I cast (the garment of) love over thee from Me: and (this) in order that thou mayest be reared under Mine eye

verses.ar: اِذۡ تَمۡشِيۡ٘ اُخۡتُكَ فَتَقُوۡلُ هَلۡ اَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلٰي مَنۡ يَّكۡفُلُهٗؕ فَرَجَعۡنٰكَ اِلٰ٘ي اُمِّكَ كَيۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَ ࣢ؕ وَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسًا فَنَجَّيۡنٰكَ مِنَ الۡغَمِّ وَفَتَنّٰكَ فُتُوۡنًا ࣢ࣞ فَلَبِثۡتَ سِنِيۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اَهۡلِ مَدۡيَنَ ࣢ۙ ثُمَّ جِئۡتَ عَلٰي قَدَرٍ يّٰمُوۡسٰي
verses.en: Behold! thy sister goeth forth and saith, 'shall I show you one who will nurse and rear the (child)?' So We brought thee back to thy mother, that her eye might be cooled and she should not grieve. Then thou didst slay a man, but We saved thee from trouble, and We tried thee in various ways. Then didst thou tarry a number of years with the people of Midian. Then didst thou come hither as ordained, O Moses

verses.ar: وَاصۡطَنَعۡتُكَ لِنَفۡسِيۡۚ‏
verses.en: And I have prepared thee for Myself (for service)

verses.ar: اِذۡهَبۡ اَنۡتَ وَاَخُوۡكَ بِاٰيٰتِيۡ وَلَا تَنِيَا فِيۡ ذِكۡرِيۡۚ‏
verses.en: Go, thou and thy brother, with My Signs, and slacken not, either of you, in keeping Me in remembrance

verses.ar: اِذۡهَبَا٘ اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ اِنَّهٗ طَغٰيۚۖ‏
verses.en: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh, for he has indeed transgressed all bounds

verses.ar: فَقُوۡلَا لَهٗ قَوۡلًا لَّيِّنًا لَّعَلَّهٗ يَتَذَكَّرُ اَوۡ يَخۡشٰي
verses.en: But speak to him mildly; perchance he may take warning or fear (Allah)

verses.ar: قَالَا رَبَّنَا٘ اِنَّنَا نَخَافُ اَنۡ يَّفۡرُطَ عَلَيۡنَا٘ اَوۡ اَنۡ يَّطۡغٰي
verses.en: They (Moses and Aaron) said: "Our Lord! We fear lest he hasten with insolence against us, or lest he transgress all bounds

verses.ar: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَا٘ اِنَّنِيۡ مَعَكُمَا٘ اَسۡمَعُ وَاَرٰي
verses.en: He said: "Fear not: for I am with you: I hear and see (everything)

verses.ar: فَاۡتِيٰهُ فَقُوۡلَا٘ اِنَّا رَسُوۡلَا رَبِّكَ فَاَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ ࣢ۙ وَلَا تُعَذِّبۡهُمۡؕ قَدۡ جِئۡنٰكَ بِاٰيَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَؕ وَالسَّلٰمُ عَلٰي مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الۡهُدٰي
verses.en: So go ye both to him, and say, 'Verily we are messengers sent by thy Lord: Send forth, therefore, the Children of Israel with us, and afflict them not: with a Sign, indeed, have we come from thy Lord! and peace to all who follow guidance

verses.ar: اِنَّا قَدۡ اُوۡحِيَ اِلَيۡنَا٘ اَنَّ الۡعَذَابَ عَلٰي مَنۡ كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلّٰي
verses.en: Verily it has been revealed to us that the Penalty (awaits) those who reject and turn away

verses.ar: قَالَ فَمَنۡ رَّبُّكُمَا يٰمُوۡسٰي
verses.en: (When this message was delivered), (Pharaoh) said: "Who, then, O Moses, is the Lord of you two

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبُّنَا الَّذِيۡ٘ اَعۡطٰي كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلۡقَهٗ ثُمَّ هَدٰي
verses.en: He said: "Our Lord is He Who gave to each (created) thing its form and nature, and further, gave (it) guidance

verses.ar: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ الۡقُرُوۡنِ الۡاُوۡلٰي
verses.en: (Pharaoh) said: "What then is the condition of previous generations

verses.ar: قَالَ عِلۡمُهَا عِنۡدَ رَبِّيۡ فِيۡ كِتٰبٍۚ لَا يَضِلُّ رَبِّيۡ وَلَا يَنۡسَيؗ‏
verses.en: He replied: "The knowledge of that is with my Lord, duly recorded: my Lord never errs, nor forgets

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ مَهۡدًا وَّسَلَكَ لَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا سُبُلًا وَّاَنۡزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًؕ فَاَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهٖ٘ اَزۡوَاجًا مِّنۡ نَّبَاتٍ شَتّٰي
verses.en: He Who has, made for you the earth like a carpet spread out; has enabled you to go about therein by roads (and channels); and has sent down water from the sky." With it have We produced diverse pairs of plants each separate from the others

verses.ar: كُلُوۡا وَارۡعَوۡا اَنۡعَامَكُمۡؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّاُولِي النُّهٰيࣖ‏
verses.en: Eat (for yourselves) and pasture your cattle: verily, in this are Signs for men endued with understanding

verses.ar: مِنۡهَا خَلَقۡنٰكُمۡ وَفِيۡهَا نُعِيۡدُكُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا نُخۡرِجُكُمۡ تَارَةً اُخۡرٰي
verses.en: From the (earth) did We create you, and into it shall We return you, and from it shall We bring you out once again

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرَيۡنٰهُ اٰيٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَاَبٰي
verses.en: And We showed Pharaoh all Our Signs, but he did reject and refuse

verses.ar: قَالَ اَجِئۡتَنَا لِتُخۡرِجَنَا مِنۡ اَرۡضِنَا بِسِحۡرِكَ يٰمُوۡسٰي
verses.en: He said: "Hast thou come to drive us out of our land with thy magic, O Moses

verses.ar: فَلَنَاۡتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحۡرٍ مِّثۡلِهٖ فَاجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكَ مَوۡعِدًا لَّا نُخۡلِفُهٗ نَحۡنُ وَلَا٘ اَنۡتَ مَكَانًا سُوًي
verses.en: But we can surely produce magic to match thine! So make a tryst between us and thee, which we shall not fail to keep - neither we nor thou - in a place where both shall have even chances

verses.ar: قَالَ مَوۡعِدُكُمۡ يَوۡمُ الزِّيۡنَةِ وَاَنۡ يُّحۡشَرَ النَّاسُ ضُحًي
verses.en: Moses said: "Your tryst is the Day of the Festival, and let the people be assembled when the sun is well up

verses.ar: فَتَوَلّٰي فِرۡعَوۡنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيۡدَهٗ ثُمَّ اَتٰي
verses.en: So Pharaoh withdrew: He concerted his plan, and then came (back)

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهُمۡ مُّوۡسٰي وَيۡلَكُمۡ لَا تَفۡتَرُوۡا عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا فَيُسۡحِتَكُمۡ بِعَذَابٍۚ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنِ افۡتَرٰي
verses.en: Moses said to him: Woe to you! Forge not ye a lie against Allah, lest He destroy you (at once) utterly by chastisement: the forger must suffer frustration

verses.ar: فَتَنَازَعُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرَهُمۡ بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَاَسَرُّوا النَّجۡوٰي
verses.en: So they disputed, one with another, over their affair, but they kept their talk secret

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ هٰذٰنِ لَسٰحِرٰنِ يُرِيۡدٰنِ اَنۡ يُّخۡرِجٰكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَرۡضِكُمۡ بِسِحۡرِهِمَا وَيَذۡهَبَا بِطَرِيۡقَتِكُمُ الۡمُثۡلٰي
verses.en: They said: "These two are certainly (expert) magicians: their object is to drive you out from your land with their magic, and to do away with your most cherished institutions

verses.ar: فَاَجۡمِعُوۡا كَيۡدَكُمۡ ثُمَّ ائۡتُوۡا صَفًّاۚ وَقَدۡ اَفۡلَحَ الۡيَوۡمَ مَنِ اسۡتَعۡلٰي
verses.en: Therefore concert your plan, and then assemble in (serried) ranks: He wins (all along) today who gains the upper hand

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰمُوۡسٰ٘ي اِمَّا٘ اَنۡ تُلۡقِيَ وَاِمَّا٘ اَنۡ نَّكُوۡنَ اَوَّلَ مَنۡ اَلۡقٰي
verses.en: They said: "O Moses! whether wilt thou that thou throw (first) or that we be the first to throw

verses.ar: قَالَ بَلۡ اَلۡقُوۡاۚ فَاِذَا حِبَالُهُمۡ وَعِصِيُّهُمۡ يُخَيَّلُ اِلَيۡهِ مِنۡ سِحۡرِهِمۡ اَنَّهَا تَسۡعٰي
verses.en: He said, "Nay, throw ye first!" Then behold their ropes and their rods-so it seemed to him on account of their magic - began to be in lively motion

verses.ar: فَاَوۡجَسَ فِيۡ نَفۡسِهٖ خِيۡفَةً مُّوۡسٰي
verses.en: So Moses conceived in his mind a (sort of) fear

verses.ar: قُلۡنَا لَا تَخَفۡ اِنَّكَ اَنۡتَ الۡاَعۡلٰي
verses.en: We said: "Fear not! for thou hast indeed the upper hand

verses.ar: وَاَلۡقِ مَا فِيۡ يَمِيۡنِكَ تَلۡقَفۡ مَا صَنَعُوۡاؕ اِنَّمَا صَنَعُوۡا كَيۡدُ سٰحِرٍؕ وَلَا يُفۡلِحُ السَّاحِرُ حَيۡثُ اَتٰي
verses.en: Throw that which is in thy right hand: Quickly will it swallow up that which they have faked what they have faked is but a magician's trick: and the magician thrives not, (no matter) where he goes

verses.ar: فَاُلۡقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًا قَالُوۡ٘ا اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّ هٰرُوۡنَ وَمُوۡسٰي
verses.en: So the magicians were thrown down to prostration: they said, "We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses

verses.ar: قَالَ اٰمَنۡتُمۡ لَهٗ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ اٰذَنَ لَكُمۡؕ اِنَّهٗ لَكَبِيۡرُكُمُ الَّذِيۡ عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحۡرَۚ فَلَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَاَرۡجُلَكُمۡ مِّنۡ خِلَافٍ وَّلَاُوصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ فِيۡ جُذُوۡعِ النَّخۡلِؗ وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ اَيُّنَا٘ اَشَدُّ عَذَابًا وَّاَبۡقٰي
verses.en: (Pharaoh) said: "Believe ye in Him before I give you permission? Surely this must be your leader, who has taught you magic! be sure I will cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and I will have you crucified on trunks of palm-trees: so shall ye know for certain, which of us can give the more severe and the more lasting punishment

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا لَنۡ نُّؤۡثِرَكَ عَلٰي مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ الۡبَيِّنٰتِ وَالَّذِيۡ فَطَرَنَا فَاقۡضِ مَا٘ اَنۡتَ قَاضٍؕ اِنَّمَا تَقۡضِيۡ هٰذِهِ الۡحَيٰوةَ الدُّنۡيَاؕ‏
verses.en: They said: "Never shall we regard thee as more than the Clear Signs that have come to us, or than Him Who created us! so decree whatever thou desirest to decree: for thou canst only decree (touching) the life of this world

verses.ar: اِنَّا٘ اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغۡفِرَ لَنَا خَطٰيٰنَا وَمَا٘ اَكۡرَهۡتَنَا عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ السِّحۡرِؕ وَاللّٰهُ خَيۡرٌ وَّاَبۡقٰي
verses.en: For us, we have believed in our Lord: may He forgive us our faults, and the magic to which thou didst compel us: for Allah is Best and Most Abiding

verses.ar: اِنَّهٗ مَنۡ يَّاۡتِ رَبَّهٗ مُجۡرِمًا فَاِنَّ لَهٗ جَهَنَّمَؕ لَا يَمُوۡتُ فِيۡهَا وَلَا يَحۡيٰي
verses.en: Verily he who comes to his Lord as a sinner (at Judgment),- for him is Hell: therein shall he neither die nor live

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ يَّاۡتِهٖ مُؤۡمِنًا قَدۡ عَمِلَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ الدَّرَجٰتُ الۡعُلٰيۙ‏
verses.en: But such as come to Him as Believers who have worked righteous deeds,- for them are ranks exalted

verses.ar: جَنّٰتُ عَدۡنٍ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاؕ وَذٰلِكَ جَزٰٓؤُا مَنۡ تَزَكّٰيࣖ‏
verses.en: Gardens of Eternity, beneath which flow rivers: they will dwell therein for aye: such is the reward of those who purify themselves (from evil)

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلٰي مُوۡسٰ٘ي ࣢ۙ اَنۡ اَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيۡ فَاضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ طَرِيۡقًا فِي الۡبَحۡرِ يَبَسًاۙ لَّا تَخٰفُ دَرَكًا وَّلَا تَخۡشٰي
verses.en: We sent an inspiration to Moses: "Travel by night with My servants, and strike a dry path for them through the sea, without fear of being overtaken (by Pharaoh) and without (any other) fear

verses.ar: فَاَتۡبَعَهُمۡ فِرۡعَوۡنُ بِجُنُوۡدِهٖ فَغَشِيَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمۡؕ‏
verses.en: Then Pharaoh pursued them with his forces, but the waters completely overwhelmed them and covered them up

verses.ar: وَاَضَلَّ فِرۡعَوۡنُ قَوۡمَهٗ وَمَا هَدٰي
verses.en: Pharaoh led his people astray instead of leading them aright

verses.ar: يٰبَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ قَدۡ اَنۡجَيۡنٰكُمۡ مِّنۡ عَدُوِّكُمۡ وَوٰعَدۡنٰكُمۡ جَانِبَ الطُّوۡرِ الۡاَيۡمَنَ وَنَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡمَنَّ وَالسَّلۡوٰي
verses.en: O ye Children of Israel! We delivered you from your enemy, and We made a Covenant with you on the right side of Mount (Sinai), and We sent down to you Manna and quails

verses.ar: كُلُوۡا مِنۡ طَيِّبٰتِ مَا رَزَقۡنٰكُمۡ وَلَا تَطۡغَوۡا فِيۡهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غَضَبِيۡۚ وَمَنۡ يَّحۡلِلۡ عَلَيۡهِ غَضَبِيۡ فَقَدۡ هَوٰي
verses.en: (Saying): "Eat of the good things We have provided for your sustenance, but commit no excess therein, lest My Wrath should justly descend on you: and those on whom descends My Wrath do perish indeed

verses.ar: وَاِنِّيۡ لَغَفَّارٌ لِّمَنۡ تَابَ وَاٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا ثُمَّ اهۡتَدٰي
verses.en: But, without doubt, I am (also) He that forgives again and again, to those who repent, believe, and do right, who,- in fine, are ready to receive true guidance

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَعۡجَلَكَ عَنۡ قَوۡمِكَ يٰمُوۡسٰي
verses.en: (When Moses was up on the Mount, Allah said:) "What made thee hasten in advance of thy people, O Moses

verses.ar: قَالَ هُمۡ اُولَآءِ عَلٰ٘ي اَثَرِيۡ وَعَجِلۡتُ اِلَيۡكَ رَبِّ لِتَرۡضٰي
verses.en: He replied: "Behold, they are close on my footsteps: I hastened to thee, O my Lord, to please thee

verses.ar: قَالَ فَاِنَّا قَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَوۡمَكَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِكَ وَاَضَلَّهُمُ السَّامِرِيُّ
verses.en: (Allah) said: "We have tested thy people in thy absence: the Samiri has led them astray

verses.ar: فَرَجَعَ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اِلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ غَضۡبَانَ اَسِفًا ࣢ۚ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَلَمۡ يَعِدۡكُمۡ رَبُّكُمۡ وَعۡدًا حَسَنًا ࣢ؕ اَفَطَالَ عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡعَهۡدُ اَمۡ اَرَدۡتُّمۡ اَنۡ يَّحِلَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غَضَبٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ فَاَخۡلَفۡتُمۡ مَّوۡعِدِيۡ‏
verses.en: So Moses returned to his people in a state of indignation and sorrow. He said: "O my people! did not your Lord make a handsome promise to you? Did then the promise seem to you long (in coming)? Or did ye desire that Wrath should descend from your Lord on you, and so ye broke your promise to me

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا مَا٘ اَخۡلَفۡنَا مَوۡعِدَكَ بِمَلۡكِنَا وَلٰكِنَّا حُمِّلۡنَا٘ اَوۡزَارًا مِّنۡ زِيۡنَةِ الۡقَوۡمِ فَقَذَفۡنٰهَا فَكَذٰلِكَ اَلۡقَي السَّامِرِيُّۙ‏
verses.en: They said: "We broke not the promise to thee, as far as lay in our power: but we were made to carry the weight of the ornaments of the (whole) people, and we threw them (into the fire), and that was what the Samiri suggested

verses.ar: فَاَخۡرَجَ لَهُمۡ عِجۡلًا جَسَدًا لَّهٗ خُوَارٌ فَقَالُوۡا هٰذَا٘ اِلٰهُكُمۡ وَاِلٰهُ مُوۡسٰي ࣢ۙۚ فَنَسِيَؕ‏
verses.en: Then he brought out (of the fire) before the (people) the image of a calf: It seemed to low: so they said: This is your god, and the god of Moses, but (Moses) has forgotten

verses.ar: اَفَلَا يَرَوۡنَ اَلَّا يَرۡجِعُ اِلَيۡهِمۡ قَوۡلًا ࣢ۙ وَّلَا يَمۡلِكُ لَهُمۡ ضَرًّا وَّلَا نَفۡعًاࣖ‏
verses.en: Could they not see that it could not return them a word (for answer), and that it had no power either to harm them or to do them good

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ هٰرُوۡنُ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ يٰقَوۡمِ اِنَّمَا فُتِنۡتُمۡ بِهٖۚ وَاِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ الرَّحۡمٰنُ فَاتَّبِعُوۡنِيۡ وَاَطِيۡعُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرِيۡ‏
verses.en: Aaron had already, before this said to them: "O my people! ye are being tested in this: for verily your Lord is (Allah) Most Gracious; so follow me and obey my command

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا لَنۡ نَّبۡرَحَ عَلَيۡهِ عٰكِفِيۡنَ حَتّٰي يَرۡجِعَ اِلَيۡنَا مُوۡسٰي
verses.en: They had said: "We will not abandon this cult, but we will devote ourselves to it until Moses returns to us

verses.ar: قَالَ يٰهٰرُوۡنُ مَا مَنَعَكَ اِذۡ رَاَيۡتَهُمۡ ضَلُّوۡ٘اۙ‏
verses.en: (Moses) said: "O Aaron! what kept thee back, when thou sawest them going wrong

verses.ar: اَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِؕ اَفَعَصَيۡتَ اَمۡرِيۡ‏
verses.en: From following me? Didst thou then disobey my order

verses.ar: قَالَ يَبۡنَؤُمَّ لَا تَاۡخُذۡ بِلِحۡيَتِيۡ وَلَا بِرَاۡسِيۡۚ اِنِّيۡ خَشِيۡتُ اَنۡ تَقُوۡلَ فَرَّقۡتَ بَيۡنَ بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ وَلَمۡ تَرۡقُبۡ قَوۡلِيۡ‏
verses.en: (Aaron) replied: "O son of my mother! Seize (me) not by my beard nor by (the hair of) my head! Truly I feared lest thou shouldst say, 'Thou has caused a division among the children of Israel, and thou didst not respect my word

verses.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكَ يٰسَامِرِيُّ
verses.en: (Moses) said: "What then is thy case, O Samiri

verses.ar: قَالَ بَصُرۡتُ بِمَا لَمۡ يَبۡصُرُوۡا بِهٖ فَقَبَضۡتُ قَبۡضَةً مِّنۡ اَثَرِ الرَّسُوۡلِ فَنَبَذۡتُهَا وَكَذٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتۡ لِيۡ نَفۡسِيۡ‏
verses.en: He replied: "I saw what they saw not: so I took a handful (of dust) from the footprint of the Messenger, and threw it (into the calf): thus did my soul suggest to me

verses.ar: قَالَ فَاذۡهَبۡ فَاِنَّ لَكَ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ اَنۡ تَقُوۡلَ لَا مِسَاسَࣕ وَاِنَّ لَكَ مَوۡعِدًا لَّنۡ تُخۡلَفَهٗۚ وَانۡظُرۡ اِلٰ٘ي اِلٰهِكَ الَّذِيۡ ظَلۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ عَاكِفًاؕ لَنُحَرِّقَنَّهٗ ثُمَّ لَنَنۡسِفَنَّهٗ فِي الۡيَمِّ نَسۡفًا
verses.en: (Moses) said: "Get thee gone! but thy (punishment) in this life will be that thou wilt say, 'touch me not'; and moreover (for a future penalty) thou hast a promise that will not fail: Now look at thy god, of whom thou hast become a devoted worshipper: We will certainly (melt) it in a blazing fire and scatter it broadcast in the sea

verses.ar: اِنَّمَا٘ اِلٰهُكُمُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَؕ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمًا
verses.en: But the god of you all is the One Allah: there is no god but He: all things He comprehends in His knowledge

verses.ar: كَذٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ اَنۭۡ بَآءِ مَا قَدۡ سَبَقَۚ وَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنٰكَ مِنۡ لَّدُنَّا ذِكۡرًاۖۚ‏
verses.en: Thus do We relate to thee some stories of what happened before: for We have sent thee a Message from Our own Presence

verses.ar: مَنۡ اَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهُ فَاِنَّهٗ يَحۡمِلُ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ وِزۡرًاۙ‏
verses.en: If any do turn away therefrom, verily they will bear a burden on the Day of judgment

verses.ar: خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهِؕ وَسَآءَ لَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ حِمۡلًاۙ‏
verses.en: They will abide in this (state): and grievous will the burden be to them on that Day

verses.ar: يَّوۡمَ يُنۡفَخُ فِي الصُّوۡرِ وَنَحۡشُرُ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ يَوۡمَئِذٍ زُرۡقًاۚۖۙ‏
verses.en: The Day when the Trumpet will be sounded: that Day, We shall gather the sinful, blear-eyed (with terror)

verses.ar: يَّتَخَافَتُوۡنَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ اِنۡ لَّبِثۡتُمۡ اِلَّا عَشۡرًا
verses.en: In whispers will they consult each other: "Yet tarried not longer than ten (Days)

verses.ar: نَحۡنُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ اِذۡ يَقُوۡلُ اَمۡثَلُهُمۡ طَرِيۡقَةً اِنۡ لَّبِثۡتُمۡ اِلَّا يَوۡمًاࣖ‏
verses.en: We know best what they will say, when their leader most eminent in conduct will say: "Ye tarried not longer than a day

verses.ar: وَيَسۡـَٔلُوۡنَكَ عَنِ الۡجِبَالِ فَقُلۡ يَنۡسِفُهَا رَبِّيۡ نَسۡفًاۙ‏
verses.en: They ask thee concerning the Mountains: say, "My Lord will uproot them and scatter them as dust

verses.ar: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًا صَفۡصَفًاۙ‏
verses.en: He will leave them as plains smooth and level

verses.ar: لَّا تَرٰي فِيۡهَا عِوَجًا وَّلَا٘ اَمۡتًاؕ‏
verses.en: Nothing crooked or curved wilt thou see in their place

verses.ar: يَوۡمَئِذٍ يَّتَّبِعُوۡنَ الدَّاعِيَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهٗۚ وَخَشَعَتِ الۡاَصۡوَاتُ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ فَلَا تَسۡمَعُ اِلَّا هَمۡسًا
verses.en: On that Day will they follow the Caller (straight): no crookedness (can they show) him: all sounds shall humble themselves in the Presence of (Allah) Most Gracious: nothing shalt thou hear but the tramp of their feet (as they march)

verses.ar: يَوۡمَئِذٍ لَّا تَنۡفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ اِلَّا مَنۡ اَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وَرَضِيَ لَهٗ قَوۡلًا
verses.en: On that Day shall no intercession avail except for those for whom permission has been granted by (Allah) Most Gracious and whose word is acceptable to Him

verses.ar: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَلَا يُحِيۡطُوۡنَ بِهٖ عِلۡمًا
verses.en: He knows what (appears to His creatures as) before or after or behind them: but they shall not compass it with their knowledge

verses.ar: وَعَنَتِ الۡوُجُوۡهُ لِلۡحَيِّ الۡقَيُّوۡمِؕ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنۡ حَمَلَ ظُلۡمًا
verses.en: (All) faces shall be humbled before (Him) - the Living, the Self-Subsisting, Eternal: hopeless indeed will be the man that carries iniquity (on his back)

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ يَّعۡمَلۡ مِنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٌ فَلَا يَخٰفُ ظُلۡمًا وَّلَا هَضۡمًا
verses.en: But he who works deeds of righteousness, and has faith, will have no fear of harm nor of any curtailment (of what is his due)

verses.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُ قُرۡاٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا وَّصَرَّفۡنَا فِيۡهِ مِنَ الۡوَعِيۡدِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُوۡنَ اَوۡ يُحۡدِثُ لَهُمۡ ذِكۡرًا
verses.en: Thus have We sent this down - an arabic Qur'an - and explained therein in detail some of the warnings, in order that they may fear Allah, or that it may cause their remembrance (of Him)

verses.ar: فَتَعٰلَي اللّٰهُ الۡمَلِكُ الۡحَقُّۚ وَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ بِالۡقُرۡاٰنِ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يُّقۡضٰ٘ي اِلَيۡكَ وَحۡيُهٗؗ وَقُلۡ رَّبِّ زِدۡنِيۡ عِلۡمًا
verses.en: High above all is Allah, the King, the Truth! Be not in haste with the Qur'an before its revelation to thee is completed, but say, "O my Lord! advance me in knowledge

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ عَهِدۡنَا٘ اِلٰ٘ي اٰدَمَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ فَنَسِيَ وَلَمۡ نَجِدۡ لَهٗ عَزۡمًاࣖ‏
verses.en: We had already, beforehand, taken the covenant of Adam, but he forgot: and We found on his part no firm resolve

verses.ar: وَاِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اسۡجُدُوۡا لِاٰدَمَ فَسَجَدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا٘ اِبۡلِيۡسَؕ اَبٰي
verses.en: When We said to the angels, "Prostrate yourselves to Adam", they prostrated themselves, but not Iblis: he refused

verses.ar: فَقُلۡنَا يٰ٘اٰدَمُ اِنَّ هٰذَا عَدُوٌّ لَّكَ وَلِزَوۡجِكَ فَلَا يُخۡرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ الۡجَنَّةِ فَتَشۡقٰي
verses.en: Then We said: "O Adam! verily, this is an enemy to thee and thy wife: so let him not get you both out of the Garden, so that thou art landed in misery

verses.ar: اِنَّ لَكَ اَلَّا تَجُوۡعَ فِيۡهَا وَلَا تَعۡرٰيۙ‏
verses.en: There is therein (enough provision) for thee not to go hungry nor to go naked

verses.ar: وَاَنَّكَ لَا تَظۡمَؤُا فِيۡهَا وَلَا تَضۡحٰي
verses.en: Nor to suffer from thirst, nor from the sun's heat

verses.ar: فَوَسۡوَسَ اِلَيۡهِ الشَّيۡطٰنُ قَالَ يٰ٘اٰدَمُ هَلۡ اَدُلُّكَ عَلٰي شَجَرَةِ الۡخُلۡدِ وَمُلۡكٍ لَّا يَبۡلٰي
verses.en: But Satan whispered evil to him: he said, "O Adam! shall I lead thee to the Tree of Eternity and to a kingdom that never decays

verses.ar: فَاَكَلَا مِنۡهَا فَبَدَتۡ لَهُمَا سَوۡاٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخۡصِفٰنِ عَلَيۡهِمَا مِنۡ وَّرَقِ الۡجَنَّةِؗ وَعَصٰ٘ي اٰدَمُ رَبَّهٗ فَغَوٰيࣕۖ‏
verses.en: In the result, they both ate of the tree, and so their nakedness appeared to them: they began to sew together, for their covering, leaves from the Garden: thus did Adam disobey his Lord, and allow himself to be seduced

verses.ar: ثُمَّ اجۡتَبٰهُ رَبُّهٗ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡهِ وَهَدٰي
verses.en: But his Lord chose him (for His Grace): He turned to him, and gave him Guidance

verses.ar: قَالَ اهۡبِطَا مِنۡهَا جَمِيۡعًاۭ بَعۡضُكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّۚ فَاِمَّا يَاۡتِيَنَّكُمۡ مِّنِّيۡ هُدًي ࣢ۙ فَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشۡقٰي
verses.en: He said: "Get ye down, both of you,- all together, from the Garden, with enmity one to another: but if, as is sure, there comes to you Guidance from Me, whosoever follows My Guidance, will not lose his way, nor fall into misery

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ اَعۡرَضَ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِيۡ فَاِنَّ لَهٗ مَعِيۡشَةً ضَنۡكًا وَّنَحۡشُرُهٗ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ اَعۡمٰي
verses.en: But whosoever turns away from My Message, verily for him is a life narrowed down, and We shall raise him up blind on the Day of Judgment

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرۡتَنِيۡ٘ اَعۡمٰي وَقَدۡ كُنۡتُ بَصِيۡرًا
verses.en: He will say: "O my Lord! why hast Thou raised me up blind, while I had sight (before)

verses.ar: قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ اَتَتۡكَ اٰيٰتُنَا فَنَسِيۡتَهَاۚ وَكَذٰلِكَ الۡيَوۡمَ تُنۡسٰي
verses.en: (Allah) will say: "Thus didst Thou, when Our Signs came unto thee, disregard them: so wilt thou, this day, be disregarded

verses.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِيۡ مَنۡ اَسۡرَفَ وَلَمۡ يُؤۡمِنۭۡ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهٖؕ وَلَعَذَابُ الۡاٰخِرَةِ اَشَدُّ وَاَبۡقٰي
verses.en: And thus do We recompense him who transgresses beyond bounds and believes not in the Signs of his Lord: and the Penalty of the Hereafter is far more grievous and more enduring

verses.ar: اَفَلَمۡ يَهۡدِ لَهُمۡ كَمۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡقُرُوۡنِ يَمۡشُوۡنَ فِيۡ مَسٰكِنِهِمۡؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّاُولِي النُّهٰيࣖ‏
verses.en: Is it not a warning to such men (to call to mind) how many generations before them We destroyed, in whose haunts they (now) move? Verily, in this are Signs for men endued with understanding

verses.ar: وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتۡ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًا وَّاَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّيؕ‏
verses.en: Had it not been for a Word that went forth before from thy Lord, (their punishment) must necessarily have come; but there is a Term appointed (for respite)

verses.ar: فَاصۡبِرۡ عَلٰي مَا يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوۡعِ الشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ غُرُوۡبِهَاۚ وَمِنۡ اٰنَآئِ الَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡ وَاَطۡرَافَ النَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرۡضٰي
verses.en: Therefore be patient with what they say, and celebrate (constantly) the praises of thy Lord, before the rising of the sun, and before its setting; yea, celebrate them for part of the hours of the night, and at the sides of the day: that thou mayest have (spiritual) joy

verses.ar: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ اِلٰي مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهٖ٘ اَزۡوَاجًا مِّنۡهُمۡ زَهۡرَةَ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا ࣢ۙ لِنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيۡهِؕ وَرِزۡقُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٌ وَّاَبۡقٰي
verses.en: Nor strain thine eyes in longing for the things We have given for enjoyment to parties of them, the splendour of the life of this world, through which We test them: but the provision of thy Lord is better and more enduring

verses.ar: وَاۡمُرۡ اَهۡلَكَ بِالصَّلٰوةِ وَاصۡطَبِرۡ عَلَيۡهَاؕ لَا نَسۡـَٔلُكَ رِزۡقًاؕ نَحۡنُ نَرۡزُقُكَؕ وَالۡعَاقِبَةُ لِلتَّقۡوٰي
verses.en: Enjoin prayer on thy people, and be constant therein. We ask thee not to provide sustenance: We provide it for thee. But the (fruit of) the Hereafter is for righteousness

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لَوۡلَا يَاۡتِيۡنَا بِاٰيَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهٖؕ اَوَلَمۡ تَاۡتِهِمۡ بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِي الصُّحُفِ الۡاُوۡلٰي
verses.en: They say: "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has not a Clear Sign come to them of all that was in the former Books of revelation

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ اَنَّا٘ اَهۡلَكۡنٰهُمۡ بِعَذَابٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ لَقَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا لَوۡلَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡتَ اِلَيۡنَا رَسُوۡلًا فَنَتَّبِعَ اٰيٰتِكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ نَّذِلَّ وَنَخۡزٰي
verses.en: And if We had inflicted on them a penalty before this, they would have said: "Our Lord! If only Thou hadst sent us a messenger, we should certainly have followed Thy Signs before we were humbled and put to shame

verses.ar: قُلۡ كُلٌّ مُّتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوۡاۚ فَسَتَعۡلَمُوۡنَ مَنۡ اَصۡحٰبُ الصِّرَاطِ السَّوِيِّ وَمَنِ اهۡتَدٰيࣖ‏
verses.en: Say: "Each one (of us) is waiting: wait ye, therefore, and soon shall ye know who it is that is on the straight and even way, and who it is that has received Guidance
